title: Uniform variance-influence bound for hypergraph properties
exact_target: For each fixed $r>=3$, does $C_r$ exist such that for every $n>=r$, every p in (0,1), and every Boolean property of r-uniform hypergraphs invariant under vertex relabeling, $Var_p(f)<=C_r$ $I_p(f)/(\log $ $n)^(r/(r-1))$?

sources.citation: OpenAI, manuscript citation page. Source of the formulation motivating this local problem.
